ambient_events: Cloud shadow slides across the floor in a slow, silent tide.
The city glitters on far below, a machine you are, for now, above.
description: The whole crown of the tower, and it knows it. A single volume of glass and pale stone under a five-metre ceiling, wrapped three-sixty in an unbroken view: the bay, the mountains, the grey sprawl of Coldwater all laid at your feet and none of it able to look back in. An emperor bed floats on a raised platform beneath the north glass; a sunken lounge, a private bar, a fireplace of honed basalt. Nothing up here is loud, because nothing up here has to be. Step south to the landing.

window.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass runs the whole west wall, black-framed and seamless, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the west window
